recipes.oracle_text:
Return target creature card from a graveyard to its owner's hand.
Conspire (As you cast this spell, you may tap two untapped creatures you control that share a color with it. When you do, copy it and you may choose a new target for the copy.)

recipe_coverage: Oracle-reviewed single-card recovery: eligible alternatives and full-zone indices, type/color/value restrictions, graveyard ownership, exact/insufficient mana, empty zone, ordered unaffected zones, target departure and index shift through a real Reclaim response, populated-zone snapshot replay. Reanimation also checks entry characteristics and subsequent death ownership; subtype bonuses are explicit. Multi-target recovery, graveyard shroud, replacement effects, and exceptional card types remain separate. This declaration tests the normal hand-cast recovery component; Conspire remains separate.
